Their 90-day guarantee says you have to use the product for the full 90 days, but they say I don't qualify for a refund because I had a monthly subscription, not a one-time purchase. They offered me only a 20% refund on the last shipment. Also, the phone number they list on their website is a dead line, you just get a busy signal. The address they list in Sheridan, Wyoming, is a known "front" for international businesses, mostly from China. When the packages arrive they come from an individual, residential address. It was a different person and address on each shipment. Very suspicious. They advertise on social media like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Don't fall for it! I lost $168 to these scammers.
